_comment: Firestore, Hosting and one Cloud Function.
The earlier note here said Hosting could not work because everything under
/api is a Node serverless function. That is still true of Hosting alone; it
is no longer true of the project, because functions/index.js now serves
those routes and the rewrites below send /api/** to it. The admin panel and
every route behind it work on Firebase exactly as they do on Vercel.
Deploy is two steps, in this order:
public/ is assembled by that script from an allowlist, so no server file
can be published by accident. Never point hosting.public at '.'.
vercel.json is left untouched, so the Vercel deployment keeps working and
you can move back or run both while you compare.
